summary: Comprehensive testing of ExplainaPro caption burn-in feature and editor functionality. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend Editor page fully functional with all 6 tabs (Script, Assets, Music, Voice, Captions, Effects). Caption styles selection works correctly. Export MP4 with caption burn-in successfully renders videos with ASS subtitles. State persistence works within browser session but lost between Playwright browser context switches (expected behavior).

integration_issues.issue: Zustand persist middleware stores state in localStorage, but new browser sessions don't retain the state. This is expected behavior but causes issues in automated testing across multiple page navigations.
integration_issues.impact: LOW - This is expected behavior for localStorage-based persistence

critical_code_review_comments: Caption burn-in implementation using FFmpeg ASS subtitles is well implemented
All 6 caption styles (bold-pop, netflix, minimal, tiktok, neon, glass) correctly map to ASS format
Frontend correctly passes captionStyleId from useCaptionStore to render endpoint
Preview canvas shows styled caption overlay matching selected caption style
Render endpoint properly accepts captionStyleId parameter and burns captions into video
context_for_next_testing_agent: Caption burn-in feature is fully functional. Backend creates ASS subtitle files for each render job with caption style and burns them into video using FFmpeg. Frontend editor has all 6 tabs working. All 6 caption styles are selectable. Export MP4 button correctly passes captionStyleId to render endpoint. State persistence works via Zustand persist middleware with localStorage. Videos are rendered to /app/backend/renders/ directory.
